title: CLOSER TO THEE, MY FATHER, DRAW ME
stanzas: Closer to thee, my Father, draw me, I long for thine embrace; Closer within thine arms enfold me, I seek a resting place.
Closer to thee, my Saviour, draw me, Nor let me leave thee more; Fain would I feel thine arms around me, And count my wanderings o'er.
Closer by thy sweet Spirit draw me, Till I am all like thee; Quicken, refine, and wash and cleanse me, Till I am pure and free.
chorus: Closer with the cords of love, Draw me to thyself above; Closer draw me, To thyself above.
